home.heading: What is Zen Space?
home.block1: Zen Space is a creative software studio that designs and engineers websites and digital products where clean architecture meets bold visual ideas.
home.block2: Obsessed with motion and detail, we combine GSAP animation, 3D, particles, and effects with solid engineering to build experiences that feel alive without sacrificing performance.
home.block3: Whether you are launching a product or reinventing your brand online, if you value craft and a discerning eye, we should talk.

journey.title: Project Journey
journey.intro: Every engagement follows the same deliberate path: we listen first, shape the idea, then build it with care until it is ready for the world.

discover.title: Discover
discover.description: We start by listening—goals, audience and constraints—so the brief reflects the real problem before a single pixel is drawn.

define.title: Define
define.description: Ideas become scope: user flows, architecture and milestones are mapped out so everyone knows what we are building and why.

design.title: Design
design.description: Art direction, interface and motion explorations. We prototype the key moments early and refine them with honest feedback loops.

develop.title: Develop
develop.description: Frontend and backend built together with performance, accessibility and maintainability baked in—not bolted on at the end.

deliver.title: Deliver
deliver.description: QA, launch and handoff with documentation and care. Afterwards we keep iterating, because great products are never really finished.

process.question: How do projects usually start?
process.answer: With a conversation. We book an intro call to understand your goals, then put together a short proposal with scope, phases and an estimated timeline.

timeline.question: How long does a typical project take?
timeline.answer: Most engagements run between six and twelve weeks depending on scope. Larger products are split into phases so you see working results early instead of waiting for a big-bang launch.

collaboration.question: Do you work with our designers or developers?
collaboration.answer: Yes. We can join your existing team as specialists or run the project end to end. Shared repositories, clear docs and regular demos keep everyone aligned either way.

stack.question: What technologies do you use?
stack.answer: Our core stack is Vue and Nuxt with GSAP for motion, plus Node and headless services on the backend. We adapt to the tools your team already trusts when it makes sense.

handoff.question: What happens after launch?
handoff.answer: Every project ships with documentation and a handoff session. We also offer ongoing support agreements for teams that want us close by while the product grows.

privacy.name: Privacy
privacy.title: Privacy policy & cookies
privacy.p1: We care about your (and our) privacy. That’s why we don’t use cookies on this website, and we’re not planning to. We’re not interested in tracking visitors or collecting data about you, that’s just not what we do.
privacy.p2: Our only goal is to share our work with you. Nothing more, nothing less.
privacy.p3: That said, our website is hosted by a third-party provider, and they might use their own cookies for things like security or basic site performance. That part is outside of our control, but from our side, we keep things as cookie-free as possible.
privacy.p4: We don't sell food either, but our advice is to eat more vegetables to stay healthy. We also encourage you to support local producers; Argentine yerba mate and malbec are among the wonders of the world.
privacy.p5: Today, imagine it. Tomorrow, ship it.
